name: luna-pool-orchestrator
description: The first Heliolune adapter: cost-first supervised engineering orchestration through a blocking local MCP boundary.

interface.shortDescription: Supervise capable models; delegate bounded work cheaply.
interface.longDescription: Heliolune's first adapter runs four function-affine Luna/max workers behind one blocking MCP call so Sol can retain architecture, risk, review, and final acceptance while avoiding worker polling and transcript inflation. Built-in usage accounting estimates worker cost and same-token savings.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $luna-pool-orchestrator to delegate this bounded engineering task to a hidden Luna/max lane.
